short: Turns off or breaks security tools and logs so defenders see nothing.
analogy: Switches off the cameras and the alarm.

solutionNotes.siem: Notices that logs stopped arriving or that security settings changed.
solutionNotes.edr: Protects itself from being switched off and alerts on attempts to tamper with protection.
solutionNotes.vm: Checks settings and firmware for compliance with standards.
solutionNotes.caasm: Shows computers where the protection agent has disappeared or isn’t working.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Spots changes to firewalls, logs and the structure of cloud accounts.
